_comment: CLOSING template for the RST Jaipur 2026 data-use survey.
Sent as a template rather than free-form because the close fires after the
respondent has finished answering, which can be hours or days after they
started - the flow allows an hour per question. A participant who begins in
the afternoon and finishes the next morning is outside the 24-hour window,
and a free-form close would fail silently with 63016: they answer every
question and hear nothing back. As a template it delivers either way.
This is the second half of the bookend rule. The 2023 RST flow had no closing
The debrief is the point of the exercise: it reveals that participants were
randomised into two question formats, which is what makes the session teach
something. Registration is handled separately, so this teases the results
No variables, so nothing to get wrong at send time.

twilio/text.body:
Thank you for completing the survey.

You took part in an experiment with two different versions of the same survey: one using plain language with clear answer options, and one more open and complex.

We want to show how the way a question is asked can change the answers - and the results - in WhatsApp surveys.

We will show what your group's answers looked like, live in the session. See you there.

_IPA Team_
